description: This header file declares functions related to the VideoService and WMMDownstreamMap components, including get/set parameter functions for boolean values used within the system.

methods.name: VideoService_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the VideoService component.

methods.name: VideoService_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the VideoService component.

methods.name: WMMdownstreamMap_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the WMM downstream map component.

methods.name: WMMdownstreamMap_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the WMM downstream map component.
